messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — I updated the Q3/Q4 GPU-hours forecast spreadsheet. leaning toward a hybrid mix: H200 for steady baseline capacity and L40S for regional burst/edge traffic. sheet: https://go.redwood/svc-capacity (comments added)
Tom: Nice, thanks. what's the planned cushion for the holiday surge? we saw ~45% spike last year. :eyes:
Sanjay: Proposal: 25% committed H200 for baseline, 20% L40S for burst/spot in each region; keep a 10% cross-region buffer. ballpark target ~2.1M GPU-hours/month at peak for Nov-Dec.
Ben: 2.1M seems high — can you show the working?
Sanjay: ```
# rough calc (monthly peak)
baseline_users = 120k
avg_tokens_per_user = 150
avg_tokens_per_hour = 12k  # example
H200_hours_baseline = 1_200_000
L40S_burst_hours = 700_000
buffer = 200_000
TOTAL = 2_100_000
```
Aisha: yep that's the same calc i have. baseline = 1.2M H200 hours, burst = 0.7M L40S, buffer 0.2M across regions = 2.1M total.
Tom: vendor lead-time update? we need to align procurement windows with Q4 demand.
Sanjay: H200 lead time from VendorA: quoted 12-16 weeks. L40S via marketplace 4-6 weeks. If we sign PO next week, earliest H200 arrival = late Q2/early Q3 depending on shipping. APAC H200 availability is tighter.
procure-bot: VendorA quote: H200 x100 units, ETA 98 days, unit price locked for 14 days. Reply 'accept' to proceed.
Ben: risk note — committing too many H200s up front exposes us if usage growth stalls. Recommend staged commit: 50% now, 50% deferred to Q4 with a capped cancellation window (e.g., 30 days).
Aisha: Agreed. i'm negotiating phased delivery with price protection and an option to convert to H100 credits if we need cheaper capacity. Also adding a clause for partial returns if failure rate > X%.
Tom: networking note: if we shift baseline traffic across regions, we need prebooked cross-region bandwidth and a clear egress budget for private deployments.
Sanjay: i'll run a regional allocation matrix — shifting APAC baseline to L40S where H200 supply is constrained, keep EU/NA as H200-heavy. Also adding a failure-mode: fallback to hosted API in the region for non-sensitive traffic.
Ben: action items: @Sanjay update region allocation + cost delta, @Ben draft staged PO T&Cs, @Aisha confirm burst budget number and negotiating levers. meeting Thurs 14:00 to lock commit plan. :white_check_mark:
Aisha: noted. I'll also confirm estimated incremental network egress costs (prelim: +$0.02 per peak-hour equivalent in APAC if we cross-region failover).
Tom: ok. if we can secure a 6-8 week partial H200 delivery window for the first tranche, and keep L40S for immediate edge capacity, that should smooth ramp. :thumbsup:
procure-bot: Reminder scheduled: PO-draft due in 48h for VendorA negotiation.
Ben: thanks — i'll start the PO draft and tag legal for staged-commit language.
Aisha: thanks team — will update the sheet and share the revised numbers before the Thu sync.
